guardrails.fix: await the promise, return it, end it with .catch(...) that records a Developer diagnostics log, or mark a deliberate fire-and-forget with `void`.
fix what the oxlint message names at its root: handle the promise, cover every union member, throw and reject Error objects with { cause }, keep control flow out of finally. Do not silence the rule.

guardrails.fix: call spawn/execFile with direct argv and an options object holding windowsHide: true (false only for a program whose window the user should see); never exec/execSync or shell: true.

in packages/*/src, report through the package's logger or a Developer diagnostics log instead of console.*.
write `Harness: <name>` and `Model: <id>` lines in the PR or issue description (several allowed, comma-separated), or add the harness:<name> and model:<id> labels.

delete the code comment and say it in the commit or PR instead; replace a React useEffect or whole client-store subscription as docs/agents/ui-state.md describes. The pre-commit hook checks staged files with node scripts/check-source-policy.mjs <files>.

read a Tobs token from ds/tobs.stylex.ts and compose a ds/ component instead of a DSH --dsw-* variable, a DSH UI import or a styled raw control; when a use goes away, shrink the baseline with node scripts/check-design-tokens.mjs --write.
edit the set files under design/tokens/ (wired by tobs.resolver.json) and run pnpm tokens; never edit ds/tobs-tokens.generated.ts or ds/tobs.stylex.ts by hand.

a fix(...) PR adds or changes a vitest test that fails when the fix is removed and passes with it; run node scripts/check-regression-proof.mjs --base origin/main --title "<PR title>" locally. If no automated test can show the bug, write `No regression test: <why>` in the PR description.

edit the PR description: `Closes #N` or `Refs #N` as plain text, a `Merge risk:` line (revert, blast radius, review focus) and a `Verification:` line (checks run, results, what was not run), as .github/pull_request_template.md asks.

keep a source file at or under 1000 lines: split it by responsibility into modules that each own one concern. Files already over 1000 are baselined; CI warns when a change makes one longer. After a file drops to 1000 lines or fewer, run node scripts/health.mjs --update.
make the file typecheck instead of adding it to the tsconfig.json exclude list; after removing an entry, run node scripts/health.mjs --update.

keep always-loaded agent prose (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, apps/mobile/AGENTS.md) short: move a runbook into an on-demand doc or skill behind a one-line pointer, or turn the rule into a check. CI warns when a change makes them longer.

give the feature file a "## Sources" list of globs for the code it covers and a "## Terms" list of GLOSSARY.md entries it uses; fix a glob that matches nothing or a term the glossary lacks; when a feature gets mapped, remove it from the baseline. Find the features a change touches with node scripts/feature-impact.mjs --base=origin/main.

answer each CodeRabbit pre-merge warning: fix the root cause instead of a symptom patch, update or supersede the ADR you contradict, reuse the existing module, use the GLOSSARY.md term, and name a verification run for each touched feature (node scripts/feature-impact.mjs --base=origin/main). The checks are advisory; a finding that recurs becomes an L2 rule.

run the replay command from the failing run's JSON in nightly-evidence on a freshly launched Host, find the uncaught page error or blank shell at that step and fix its root cause. Skip a control only when it is destructive or leaves the Host.

a metric more than 20% over its 7-night median raises a warning in the nightly summary: bisect the nights between with scripts/perf-idle-timeline.mjs (A/B protocol in the verify-deepseekbot performance guide) and fix the change that caused it.
